AA2219 aluminum alloy plate (T87) and ring (T851) were examined. The temper conditions are as follows:
- T87: solution treated at 807 K (534°C) for 1 hour + 7% stretched followed by aging at 436 K (163°C) for 24 hours
- T851: solution treated at 807 K (534°C) for 1 hour + stress relieved by 3% stretching followed by aging at 436 K (163°C) for 24 hours

The rings (T851) were processed through forging route involving upsetting with intermittent re-heating followed by piercing and ring rolling. A quench delay of 87 seconds was given for the rings.
